_about: Synthetic bars built by hand for the reconcile runner; never real prices, made-up tickers. Every thesis: long, short horizon, stop entry 101, stop 98, target 106, invalidation 99, window 2026-11-17 09:30-16:00 New York. daily: [session, o, h, l, c]; minutes: {session: [[HH:MM New York, o, h, l, c]]}; corporate_actions: ex-dates.

SYNA._case: fills on day 1 (minutes), target on day 2 (daily)

SYNB._case: never reaches the entry, no stop, closes above invalidation: the window ends unfilled

SYND._case: split ex-date on day 1 while PROPOSED
